C-LOCAL-CARD-ARTWORK.Summary: Implement the user-approved local card artwork package, corrected dealer fallback/source, incremental updater and offline verification.

Goals.Goal: Bundle the audited car-card images and supporting artwork, excluding galleries.
Resolve local primary artwork then local official thumbnail then cached network artwork for new URLs.
Keep Used, Legendary and Brand Central usable after a cold offline launch with a labelled bundled dealer snapshot.
Replace the broken Used endpoint with a verified public source; normalize car IDs and avoid invalid country requests.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve Provider architecture, current styles, public TLS validation and existing work; use FVM.
Updates are incremental scripts plus network caching for unknown URLs; never download galleries.
No commit/push or final GRACE archive without user instruction.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No gallery caching, unrelated redesign or account changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Every audited bundled image matches its size/hash and local card rendering does not require network.
Cold offline dealer data and Brand Central render usable cards on Mac and 390px phone.
Fallback, source parsing, partial failure and incremental update checks pass; native offline screenshots and runtime evidence are recorded.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: Dart MCP targeted tests and analyzer; Python updater integrity checks; native Mac/iPhone offline checks.
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Local asset coverage, exact bundled hashes, no outbound image requests, cold native screenshots.
